title: A La Carte Price List of the Personal Services Plan
content:
A la carte services under the Personal Services Plan are priced separately and never drawn from personal service hours. The list prices are the same on every tier; the tiers differ in how many grocery deliveries each calendar month carry no delivery fee and in the member discount deducted from a la carte charges for package holders.

## List prices (every tier)

| Service | Price |
|---|---|
| Private transportation | 3.25 USD per mile, with a minimum charge of 18.00 USD per trip |
| Handyman work requested by the resident | 58.00 USD per hour, with a minimum of 1.0 hour billed per visit |
| Overnight companion | 295.00 USD flat per night |
| Grocery delivery | 9.95 USD per delivery |

## Tier allowances

| Tier | Grocery deliveries per calendar month without the delivery fee | Member discount on a la carte services |
|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 0 | 0% |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 0 | 5% |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 2 | 5% |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 2 | 10% |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 4 | 10% |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 8 | 15% |

## Illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

- A hypothetical 4-mile trip priced at 3.25 USD per mile comes to 13.00 USD, below the 18.00 USD minimum, so the list charge is 18.00 USD; a 10-mile trip comes to 32.50 USD.
- A hypothetical handyman visit of 0.5 hour is billed at the 1.0 hour minimum, a list charge of 58.00 USD.
- On the Comfort Package a hypothetical 32.50 USD transportation charge less the 10% member discount is 29.25 USD.
